Doesn't enumerate the list or a count, so no update needed there. I have enough to answer.

## Source files that must change

- `src/server/jobs/scheduler.ts` — the `CADENCE_MINUTES` table itself needs the new entry
- `src/server/jobs/queue.ts` — `JobKind` union must gain the new literal, and `runHandler`'s switch needs a new case dispatching to the job module
- `src/server/jobs/index.ts` — barrel re-exports every `run*Job` function for the admin "run now" action and the test suite

## Documents that go stale

These all hardcode "the seven job kinds" and/or the full `CADENCE_MINUTES` table (job kind + minutes), so an eighth entry makes each of them factually wrong until updated:

- `docs/design/background-jobs.md` — DES-060 cadence table and DES-061 job-kind table
- `docs/adr/ADR-016-interval-scheduler.md` — full cadence table, "seven independent timers"
- `docs/glossary.md` — "Job kind — one of …" definition
- `docs/ops/runbook-scheduler-and-queue.md` — cadence table with owner/runbook per kind
- `docs/ops/index.md` — "seven job kinds" table with cadence/owner/runbook
- `docs/design/index.md` — multiple "the seven job kinds" references
- `docs/index.md` — nav description "...the queue and the seven job kinds"
- `docs/traceability.md` — DES-061 description "The seven job kinds and what each one is for"
- `docs/adr/ADR-018-webhook-retry-policy.md` — "one of the seven job kinds"

`docs/api/route-handlers.md` only documents the subset of job kinds with cron-trigger HTTP routes, so it's unaffected unless the new job also gets a cron route (not stated).

ANSWER: src/server/jobs/scheduler.ts, src/server/jobs/queue.ts, src/server/jobs/index.ts, docs/design/background-jobs.md, docs/adr/ADR-016-interval-scheduler.md, docs/glossary.md, docs/ops/runbook-scheduler-and-queue.md, docs/ops/index.md, docs/design/index.md, docs/index.md, docs/traceability.md, docs/adr/ADR-018-webhook-retry-policy.md
